name: Peninsula Library System E-Services
description: Free digital resources and e-services for Peninsula Library System cardholders
fullDescription: Peninsula Library System provides e-services and digital resources for cardholders from member libraries throughout San Mateo County.
whatTheyOffer:
- Ebooks and eAudiobooks (eMedia) through your member library
- eMagazines
- Research databases with full-text articles
- Online courses, videos, and homework help
- Discover & Go free passes to local museums and cultural institutions
- California Missions ebooks for elementary students
howToGetIt:
1. Have a library card from a PLS member library
2. Visit plsinfo.org/e-services
3. Choose your library to see its available resources
4. Sign in with your library card
5. Access content online
keywords: Peninsula Library System, PLS, San Mateo County, e-services, digital resources, ebooks, audiobooks, databases, Discover & Go, museum passes
